what: The pipeline configuration whose held-out results become the README headline figures (evals/HELDOUT_PROTOCOL.md 6a).
code_includes: ledgerql/result_shape.py and ledgerql/pipeline.py (the NO_DATA rule, the tautology check)
ledgerql/entity_link.py (present; used only if the decision below is on)

settings.scored_against: the frozen held-out gold (strict, gold v3 rules)

entity_link.decided_from: dev A/B (gen-only, gold v3), never from held-out results
entity_link.rule: on iff, in the dev A/B, Qwen3-30B's net pass@1 gain is at least +2 cases (strict v3, the 50 ANSWER cases, N=5, the vote's pick, with minus without linking) AND XiYanSQL-32B's net pass@1 gain is not negative; otherwise off
entity_link.setting: LEDGERQL_ENTITY_LINK=1 for on; unset for off

note: The 32B configuration for the agree-policy table is the same commit, tree, settings and linker decision. A change under ledgerql/ is a new configuration: append a declaration with its own id; never edit this one.
